profile.name: Hassam Arshad
profile.title: Technical Consultant — Banking & Trade Finance Systems
profile.tagline: building reliable banking, trade finance and cross-platform software.
profile.about: I am a Technical Consultant at Infotech, implementing, integrating and customizing Oracle FCC and Fusion Trade Innovation (FTI) for different banks. Alongside consulting, I contribute to an in-house core banking product built with Java, Spring Boot and Angular on a microservices architecture, including an event-sourced Import LC backend. Before banking, I spent two years shipping cross-platform Flutter apps for clients in Dubai and the USA.
profile.summary: Technical Consultant specialising in banking and trade finance systems (Oracle FCC, FTI, Finastra TI Plus 2). I combine hands-on core banking implementation with full-stack engineering in Java, Spring Boot and Angular, backed by a Computer Science degree from the University of Karachi (UBIT) and a background in cross-platform Flutter development.

highlights: Hands-on FCC/FTI implementation across bank branches.
Trained in FCC setup, installation, and Oracle DB administration.
Built an event-sourced trade backend in Spring Boot and Angular.
Proficient in Git, GitHub Actions, and collaborative Agile environments.
Implement, integrate, migrate, and customize Oracle FCC and FTI across different banks.
Trained in FCC and FTI setup, installation, customization, and Oracle database administration; IBM MQ; document customization requirements for FCC 6.2.4.2 and FTI 2.10.5.0.
Install and customize FCC 6.2.4.2, including Angular branding, localization, interfaces, and portlets, with core banking application connectivity.
Contribute to an in-house core banking product built with Java, Spring Boot, and Angular, structured as microservices with a Eureka discovery server.
Design and maintain an event-sourced Import LC backend, including the full amendment lifecycle (draft/submit/approve/reject) and field-level LC diffing.
Developed and maintained modular Flutter codebases for scalable cross-platform mobile applications.
Integrated RESTful APIs, Firebase Authentication, and real-time database features.
Applied secure coding practices and implemented offline-first architecture.
Designed pixel-perfect UI/UX in Flutter based on Figma wireframes and Material Design guidelines.
Integrated REST APIs and managed asynchronous data flows with Streams/Futures.
Implemented asynchronous programming techniques to handle API calls.
Used libraries like Axios and the Fetch API for secure and efficient data fetching.
Successfully integrated third-party APIs into applications.

projects.title: Trade Finance Settlement System
projects.summary: An event-sourced Import LC backend inside a Spring Boot microservices platform.
description: A trade finance backend with an event-sourced Import LC module, built as part of a Spring Boot microservices architecture with a Eureka discovery server and an Angular front end.
Every change to a Letter of Credit is stored as an event, so the full history of an LC can be replayed and any two versions compared field by field.

highlights.title: Amendment Lifecycle
highlights.text: Full draft, submit, approve and reject workflow for LC amendments.

highlights.title: Field-level Diffing
highlights.text: Shows exactly which fields changed between LC versions.

highlights.title: Microservices
highlights.text: Spring Boot services registered with a Eureka discovery server.

projects.title: E-Voting System Using Blockchain
projects.client: University of Karachi (Department of Computer Science)
projects.summary: A secure, transparent and efficient electoral platform built on a decentralized ledger.
description: The Blockchain-based Electronic Voting System addresses the persistent challenges of traditional voting by leveraging blockchain technology. The platform ensures a secure, transparent and efficient electoral process, reducing risks such as voter fraud, ballot manipulation and inefficiencies.

It introduces dual-role functionality: voters can access election details, view candidates and track their participation history, while administrators manage candidate lists, voter records and election results.

highlights.title: Enhanced Security
highlights.text: Blockchain ensures tamper-proof voting records, reducing the risk of fraud and manipulation.

highlights.title: Transparency & Trust
highlights.text: Every vote is recorded on a public ledger, providing verifiable results that build voter confidence.

highlights.title: Efficiency & Accessibility
highlights.text: Digital voting speeds up counting, minimizes errors and is inclusive for voters with disabilities.

highlights.title: Immutable Record Keeping
highlights.text: Transactions stored on the blockchain cannot be altered, keeping electoral data permanent and accurate.

projects.title: TexaTube
projects.summary: A Flutter desktop app that simplifies managing YouTube video metadata for creators and SEO specialists.
description: After mastering Flutter for web applications and building a large-scale project, I challenged myself further by diving into desktop development with Flutter. The result is TexaTube — an app that simplifies the management of YouTube video metadata for content creators and SEO specialists.
Creating TexaTube was not just about learning a new build target; it was about pushing the boundaries of what I thought possible.

projects.title: xWallet
projects.summary: A digital wallet for managing and transacting cryptocurrencies like USDT and BNB.
description: xWallet is a versatile digital wallet app for managing and transacting cryptocurrencies like USDT and BNB. The interface offers quick payment amount selection, prominently displayed balances and a list of recent transactions such as movie tickets and electronics purchases — a practical tool for everyday financial management and crypto trading.

projects.title: Real-time Chat App

The UI features a sleek, modern design focused on usability, showing recent threads with contact avatars, names and a snippet or timestamp of the last message. A search bar at the top lets users quickly find contacts or conversations.

projects.title: Industrial AI Dashboard (YTML) — Mobile
projects.summary: Compliance monitoring for an industrial setting, on the go.
description: An Industrial AI Dashboard designed for monitoring and compliance in an industrial setting. Compliance metrics are shown with pie charts across three categories: Overall, Admin and House Keeping compliance.

Below these, the dashboard lists House Keeping and Admin alerts — pallets, cardboard, trolleys, garbage, emergencies, wrong parking, crowd presence and intruders — each with incident counts and percentages. It is part of a larger system by The Disrupt Labs.

projects.title: Real Estate Finder
projects.summary: Search properties by location, price, type and bedrooms — built with ReactJS.
description: Users can search for properties by location and filter results by price, type (house or apartment), number of bedrooms and place. A clean UI makes finding your dream home easier than ever.

The project covers ReactJS fundamentals — functional components, hooks such as useState, useEffect and useContext, React Icons and React Router — and works with a large property dataset. It is fully responsive across devices.
